meta.title: A vendor blocked from re-bidding cannot place a new bid
gaps: The buyer's bid-rejection operation and the allow_rebidding:false field are not available, so the vendor is not actually placed into the blocked-from-rebidding state before the new-bid attempt.

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event where the invited QA vendor has submitted a bid; bidding still open.
steps: The invited QA vendor places a complete bid (open, price, submit).
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You are not allowed to perform this action”, and never with a server error.

plan.title: A vendor blocked from re-bidding cannot place a new bid

expected.message: You are not allowed to perform this action
